visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Adjacency Lists Instead of a Matrix
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A 5 by 5 matrix stores every possible edge and each node scans all five columns. Store only the real neighbours of each node in lists. The visiting order and output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: For a sparse graph an adjacency list stores and scans only the edges that exist, instead of n squared matrix cells. The neighbours are added in ascending order, so the visiting order stays the same.
